title: Edge of Tomorrow
description: A soldier fighting aliens gets to relive the same day over and over again, the day restarting every time he dies.

title: Scream 3
description: Murders draw a young woman (Neve Campbell), a reporter (Courteney Cox Arquette) and an ex-policeman (David Arquette) to the set of a movie inspired by horrific events that they survived.

title: Double Jeopardy
description: In an insurance scam, a man fakes his death and sets his wife up to take the blame. After serving 10 years in prison, she sets out to get revenge, immune from the law since she cannot be re-prosecuted for the same crime.

title: The Wedding Singer
description: A wedding singer loses all hope when he is abandoned at the altar by his fiancée. He meets a young woman named Julia, who enlists his help to plan her wedding. He falls in love with her and must win her over before she gets married.

title: Bridget Jones's Baby
description: Befuddled mom-to-be Bridget Jones (Renée Zellweger) must figure out which of the two men (Colin Firth, Patrick Dempsey) in her life is the father of her child.

title: Airplane II: The Sequel
description: The first commercial space shuttle sends loony Ted (Robert Hays) and his former girlfriend (Julie Hagerty) on a trip to the moon.

title: Gone Baby Gone
description: Two private investigators (Casey Affleck, Michelle Monaghan) tread dangerous ground as they scour the Boston underworld for a kidnapped child.

title: An Officer and a Gentleman
description: A hardened loner (Richard Gere) shapes up for a military drill instructor (Louis Gossett Jr.) and a factory girl (Debra Winger) from town.

title: Troy
description: While visiting Spartan King Menelaus, Trojan prince Paris falls for Menelaus' wife, Helen and takes her back to Troy. Menelaus' brother, King Agamemnon uses his brother's fury as a pretext to declare war against Troy.

title: Internal Affairs
description: A Los Angeles policeman (Richard Gere) toys with the mind of a division investigator (Andy Garcia) on his case.

title: Footloose
description: A hip Chicago teen (Kevin Bacon) moves to a Midwestern town where, thanks to a pastor (John Lithgow), dancing is outlawed.

title: Sweeney Todd: The Demon Barber of Fleet Street
description: After serving time for a crime he did not commit, a vengeful barber (Johnny Depp) and his accomplice (Helena Bonham Carter) carve up unlucky customers and bake them in meat pies.

title: The Fighting Temptations
description: Cuba Gooding Jr. and Beyoncé Knowles star in this feel-good comedy about an advertising exec who must take over a struggling gospel choir in order to receive his much-needed inheritance.

title: Scrooge
description: Dickens' London miser Ebenezer Scrooge (Albert Finney) meets the spirits of Christmases past, present and yet to come.

title: Chocolat
description: The mayor opposes a single mother (Juliette Binoche) who is opening a chocolate shop in his 1950s French village across from a church during Lent.

title: Terms of Endearment
description: A strong-willed woman (Shirley MacLaine) and her equally independent daughter (Debra Winger) keep the lines of communication open as each deals with the curveballs life throws at them.

title: Smart People
description: Recently widowed, a professor (Dennis Quaid) tries to juggle a new love (Sarah Jessica Parker) and an unexpected visit from his adoptive brother (Thomas Haden Church).

title: The Terminal
description: Unauthorized to enter the United States, an Eastern European (Tom Hanks) befriends a flight attendant (Catherine Zeta-Jones) while living in a New York airport.

title: Old School
description: Three friends try to recapture the fun of their college years by starting their own off-campus fraternity.

title: Enemy at the Gates
description: A Nazi sniper (Ed Harris) travels to Stalingrad to find and kill a Russian sharpshooter (Jude Law), the hero of the propaganda campaign of a political officer (Joseph Fiennes).

title: Coach Carter
description: A high-school basketball coach (Samuel L. Jackson) turns a losing team around, then faces criticism for pushing the athletes to put grades first.

title: Norbit
description: Though married to a terrible shrew, a man (Eddie Murphy) tries to figure out a way to be with his childhood sweetheart (Thandie Newton), who has just moved back into town.

title: 48 HRS.
description: A rumpled detective gets a slick convict released into his custody for two days to help him find a murderer in San Francisco.

title: Another 48 Hrs.
description: Jack Cates once again enlists the aid of ex-con Reggie Hammond. This time it is to take down The Iceman, a ruthless drug lord operating in the San Francisco Bay Area.

title: Dreamgirls
description: After an ambitious manager (Jamie Foxx) gives them a shot at stardom, three singers learn that fame can carry a high personal cost.

title: Piranha
description: Spring break turns gory at a popular waterside resort, where hundreds of prehistoric man-eating fish have come to dine on hapless humans.

title: Love & Basketball
description: From childhood to early adulthood, two friends (Sanaa Lathan, Omar Epps) fall in love while trying to establish basketball careers.

title: A Night at the Roxbury
description: Desperate to meet women and open their own dance club, brainless brothers Steve (Will Ferrell) and Doug Butabi (Chris Kattan) cruise Beverly Hills.

title: Serendipity
description: A man (John Cusack) and a woman (Kate Beckinsale) try to find each other after spending one night together 10 years earlier.

title: When Harry Met Sally...
description: Harry and Sally have known each other for years, and are very good friends, but they fear sex would ruin the friendship.

title: Twister
description: Storm-chasers (Helen Hunt, Bill Paxton) finalizing their divorce try to place equipment inside a tornado on the Oklahoma plains.

title: Hard Eight
description: A stranger (Philip Baker Hall) mentors a young Reno gambler (John C. Reilly) who weds a hooker (Gwyneth Paltrow) and befriends a vulgar casino regular.

title: V for Vendetta
description: After world war leads to a fascist government, a vigilante known as V (Hugo Weaving) uses terrorist tactics to fight the totalitarian state in which he now lives.

title: The Untouchables
description: Though Prohibition agent Eliot Ness attempts to take Al Capone down, even his best efforts fail due to widespread corruption within the Windy City's police force.

title: Urban Cowboy
description: A Texas farmer (John Travolta) moves to the city, immerses himself in honky-tonk and falls for a sexy cowgirl (Debra Winger).

title: Days of Thunder
description: An upstart stock-car driver goes to the edge for his manager, his brain-surgeon girlfriend and himself.

title: The Firm
description: A law-school grad uncovers a sinister secret about the Tennessee firm that made him an offer he couldn't refuse.

title: Saving Private Ryan
description: A World War II captain (Tom Hanks) and his squad (Edward Burns, Tom Sizemore) risk all to locate and send home a soldier whose three brothers died in combat.

title: The General's Daughter
description: Two investigators (John Travolta, Madeleine Stowe) find an underworld of sex and cover-ups behind an Army captain's murder.

title: Ghost
description: A slain Manhattan yuppie (Patrick Swayze) reaches out to his lover (Demi Moore), with a medium (Whoopi Goldberg) as his middle woman.

title: Selena
description: A beautiful Mexican-American singer's (Jennifer Lopez) skyrocketing international career ends abruptly.

title: Beautiful Girls
description: The opposite sex preoccupies working-class pals gathered for their high-school reunion in small-town Massachusetts.

title: Hugo
description: A resourceful orphaned boy (Asa Butterfield) and a bookish girl (Chloë Grace Moretz) set out on a quest to unlock a secret left to him by the boy's late father (Jude Law).
